preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The maximum path length l must be between 1 and n.
The maximum path weight w must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi < i + 1 for i, (pi, wi) in enumerate(edges))
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect to a valid vertex index pi less than the current vertex index i + 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi <= 10000 for pi, wi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight wi must be between 0 and 10,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of close pairs of vertices.
